title: Ittehad
requirements: Understand the meaning of unity in the scout spirit
Take part in a group activity that promotes cooperation
Show respect to different people and cultures
Help organize a small team task
Reflect on how teamwork strengthens the unit
descriptionHtml: Ittehad is a rank badge that celebrates unity, cooperation, and shared purpose. This book-style guide helps scouts learn the values behind the badge through five simple topics.

pages.title: Introduction
pages.content:
Welcome to Ittehad

This badge teaches the meaning of unity. Scouts learn that strong teams grow when everyone supports one another.

pages.title: Meaning of Unity
pages.content:
What Ittehad Means

Unity means working together with respect, kindness, and shared responsibility. It helps the group succeed and stay strong.

pages.title: Group Activity
pages.content: A scout team learns best when members listen, share, and support each other.

pages.title: Activity Guide
pages.content: Open the PDF guide for the badge activity steps and reflection questions.

pages.title: Reflection
pages.content:
Final Reflection

Ask yourself: How did I help my team today? What did I learn about working together?
